effects_provenance.raw: Apple Fritter THCA Flower Essential / 28g (Smalls) Strain Profile Apple Fritter THCA Flower is a balanced hybrid bred from Sour Apple crossed with Animal Cookies . The cross delivers exactly what its name promises — pastry-rich bag appeal with sweet apple character and the dense, frost-coated bud structure that put this strain on connoisseur menus. Effects Apple Fritter delivers a powerful, well-rounded high that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with a comfortably relaxing body buzz. The high lands fast, holds steady, and works equally well for late-afternoon decompression, social settings, or evening flavor-led wind-down. A versatile, broadly-pleasing hybrid. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sweet apple up front, with creamy vanilla through the middle and a warm pastry-and-cookie finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bakery-rich. The terpene profile reads apple-and-cream — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Apple Fritter harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Apple Fritter THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Apple Fritter THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains.
